description: Check an async doseedo task once. Returns current status, and the result (file URLs / notes) when finished. A big result comes back as a brief (each row cut to its deciding fields): parts: ["<name>" or index, …] returns those rows of the job record IN FULL — a render_score part's every receipt, a mix part's strip, rides (every point) and loudness, a supervised cue's full card (parts: ["1M7"]).

from.description: Optional, with parts naming ONE list of a spot_video cue sheet (scenes, shots, cuts, keyframes …): the first row to return (0-based). A long film's list comes in pages — an answer that was shortened says the next from.

job_id.description: Alternatively the job_id (job_…) from a submit tool or the jobs API — replaces task_id + kind.

kind.description: Which job kind created the task — the registry name the submit reply carried (generate_music, generate_sound, generate_loop, cover_stem, fill_gap, render_midi, train_instrument, render_score, mix, mix_preset, session_from_stems, spot_video, score_to_picture, reframe_video, cover_song, separate_stems, split_soundtrack, transcribe, audio_to_session, convert_project, bounce_session, analyze_song, detect_chords, beat_grid, identify_sound, check_take, analyze_midi, supervise_cues); the short codes (generate, sound, loop, coverstem, fillgap, render, train, score, mixpre, stemsess, spot, picture, reframe, cover, separate, soundtrack, session, convert, bounce, analyze, chords, beats, identify, check, harmony, supervise) are accepted aliases.

parts.description: Optional, on a finished job: the parts to return in full, by name (as the result names them) or index — e.g. ["Oboes", "Timpani"].

task_id.description: The task_id returned by a submit tool.

name: doseedo_check_task
title: Check a job
